name: thesis-mcwm-factored-v4
model_design: Five independent structured encoders and heads: event identity, elapsed time, passenger service, headway, passenger cost. Cost conditions on predicted duration and passenger increments. Fixed parent restrictions, not learned causal identification.
model_selection: Preserve the existing whole-model direct versus residual calibration selection; no new per-mechanism gate.
references: Reuse all frozen usage_v3 outcomes on the same evaluation days; unmasked has identical capacity, loss and schedule to factored.
decision: Keep normalized v3 unless a candidate reduces cost by at least 5 seconds averaged over joint50/joint75 and both demand levels, improves both training-seed averages, and no high-mismatch cell loses over 0.1 completion percentage points or increases cost over 5 seconds. Prefer fewer modifications if differences are under 5 seconds. Report every cell, including normal calibration.
scope: Development comparison on existing days; no independent confirmation claim. No target online training. No adaptive selection of days or seeds.
